risks.title: No password reset flow
risks.impact: Users locked out with no recovery path. Support burden.
risks.mitigation: Implement password reset before GA. Estimated 1-2 days.

risks.title: No email verification
risks.impact: Fake accounts, spam, no user identity validation
risks.mitigation: Add email verification step in registration

risks.title: No subscription billing active
risks.impact: Cannot monetize. Stripe configured but no tier enforcement.
risks.mitigation: Implement Stripe webhook integration and tier gating

risks.title: No user documentation
risks.impact: High support volume, poor user experience
risks.mitigation: Create FAQ, user guide, and help center

risks.title: No analytics/reports for users
risks.impact: Users cannot see their own usage data or progress reports
risks.mitigation: Add dashboard reports and export functionality
